questions.title: Whole Relation on Display
questions.description:

questions.title: Catalog Cross-Check Sheet
questions.description:
Before a shelf audit, the cataloger wants one fully renamed sheet: work, writer, length and borrowability — borrowable books last so the checked-out ones are seen first.

Schema:
- books(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT, author TEXT, pages INTEGER, available INTEGER)

Ten books from the city library's reading list are seeded. available is 1 when the book can be borrowed and 0 when it is checked out; several authors appear more than once; the shortest book is a 96-page field guide and two books tie at 176 pages.

Task:
Return title AS work, author AS writer, pages AS length_pages and available AS borrowable, ordered by borrowable ascending, then length_pages ascending, then work ascending.

Rules:
- SQLite dialect. The schema and its data are pre-seeded automatically — do not include CREATE TABLE or INSERT statements in your answer.
- Column names and order must match exactly (alias every output column).
- Row order must match exactly (use ORDER BY as specified).
